data_contract.rich_features: official Binance USD-M aggTrades, bookDepth, metrics, mark/index/premium archives; checksummed
data_contract.depth_time_axis: actual exchange timestamps with causal forward-fill; elapsed-time changes rather than assumed row cadence
data_contract.daily_boundary: notional burst and open-interest changes recomputed after daily files are concatenated
data_contract.observation: minute features are knowable only after the minute closes
data_contract.execution: entry at the following one-minute open

scenarios.name: SWING_FAILED_AUCTION_RESUMPTION
sequence: register a swing pivot only after three right-hand bars close
merge nearby same-side pivots within 0.18 lagged ATR
require observable pool age at least 15 minutes and prominence at least 0.10 lagged ATR
consume the pool on its first meaningful 0.03 to 1.20 ATR penetration
require the sweep bar to close back inside the pool
within eight minutes use the first close through that structure as the final quality verdict

require the break to agree with 240-minute displacement, directional body at least 0.60 ATR, directional 60-second flow at least 0.02, directional close location at least 0.65, and 60-second notional at least 1.20 times its lagged 120-minute median
scenarios.stop: beyond the sweep extreme plus 0.08 lagged ATR

scenarios.name: INVENTORY_BACKED_DISPLACEMENT
sequence: require the prior 15-minute move to be a non-positive side-adjusted pullback
break the fixed prior five-minute structure with body at least 0.60 ATR
require directional 60-second executed flow at least 0.20, directional close location at least 0.65, and 60-second notional at least 2.0 times its lagged 120-minute median
require side-adjusted 15-minute open-interest change at least zero
require 60-second absorption at least 0.15, price-path efficiency at most 0.60, and last-15-second flow acceleration versus the prior 45 seconds at most zero
scenarios.stop: opposite twelve-minute causal extreme plus 0.08 lagged ATR

parent_event_contract.same_side_duplicates: one parent event; latest next-minute entry and widest causal invalidation
parent_event_contract.global_constraint: at most one selected entry intent or one open position

execution_and_risk.quantity_denominator: absolute adverse entry-to-stop fill distance plus entry fee, stop fee, slippage and planned adverse funding
